notes.title: Japanese loc. Optimization fixes, Xbox release
notes.notes:
Greetings,

[h3]Japanese loc. Optimization & performance fixes[/h3]

We want to share that the game has received an update with Japanese localization. Moreover, we have successfully updated the optimization of the game, leading to faster loading times between levels, reduced overall game size, improved stability, and fixes for crashes caused by memory overflow.

[h3]Xbox release[/h3]

We are delighted to inform you that the Xbox port is OUT! The PlayStation and Switch versions are in progress and will be launched within the next month or two after the Xbox release. Our main priority was to ensure optimal performance on each console, which led to extended quality assurance testing for each build beyond our initial plans.

Here is our message to the Japanese audience:

日本の皆様へ

 本ゲームの日本語ローカライゼーションの大幅な遅れに対し、心よりお詫び申し上げます。初期のローカライゼーションで予期せぬ問題が発生し、最高の品質を確保するまでリリースを見送るという難しい決断を下すこととなりました。 

しかし、喜ばしいお知らせです。日本語ローカライゼーションはついに完成し、その品質に自信を持っております。SteamとXboxプラットフォームで「There is No Light」を日本語でお楽しみいただけるようになりました。Nintendo SwitchとPlayStationに対しては、移植への取り組みを精力的に行っております。今後のアップデートにご期待ください。

 改めて、この度の大幅な遅れに対してお詫び申し上げると共に、皆様の忍耐とサポートに心から感謝しております。私共は日本語で素晴らしいゲーム体験をお届けすることを心待ちにしており、皆様に楽しんでいただけることを願っております。 

当コミュニティの一員としてご参加いただき誠にありがとうございます。引き続き、「There is No Light」への温かいご支援をお願い申し上げます。  

Zelart一同

notes.title: Day-one update is live!
notes.notes:
Hi!
Thank you all for the feedback. Fixed some bugs and erros in day-one update.
[list]
[*] Controls. You can now activate mouse control with a joystick connected. To do this, simply move the mouse to make the game understand that you want to use it. To use a joystick, click on any button on it and control will go to the joystick.
[*] Fixed a few places where the player can get stuck.
[*] Mode change hint will appear less frequently.
[*] Fixed some places where the hero can stuck and a bug with the immortal dog in battle with one of the root giants.
[*] The sequence in the puzzles in the "Caves of Rebith" to open the elevator is now always the same and does not change after an unsuccessful input.
[*] Rewritten the logic of the elevator movement in the "Caves of Rebith", because some players had the elevator moving too slowly.
[/list]

If you found a error or encountered a bug, please write to us and we will try to fix it as soon as possible.
Thank you.
Regards, Zelart.

notes.title: Release is TOMORROW! The creation of Samedi 😈
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings!

Our team wants to remind you that only one day left until There is No Light's PC release![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132980/There_Is_No_Light/

[h3]One day left to get the game with a bigger discount than on the launch day and with an exclusive bonus! 
Pre-purchase now![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/fb92ac050047f3600b12ee6552365335595fd8db.gif[/img]
[h3]
We're also happy to announce that we'll release two bundles with other wonderful games!

The first one is with Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous: for those who enjoy dark & atmospheric RPG games.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/031f6de2c855b660075f247ced7a58aebc691be1.jpg[/img]
[h3]
The second one is with Skul: The Hero Slayer and for those who value serious challenge.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/eb9fefdba5ed230fca54089c8911d5ce4a045951.png[/img]

In today's update, we'd like to tell you about the creation of Samedi, one of the game's main Heroes, his face with a creepy smile, you probably have seen him before 😈

The need for this character arose at the stage of creating the character progression.
We needed to understand where the player would get new abilities from.
That's how the idea of a mentor was born, that will stand apart in relation to the conflict that is told in the game. Without spoilers, you can't tell his lore, so let's go straight to the design.
As always, good ideas come by accident. My eyes came across an artifact of Path of Exile and an artist sketch, which is long lost in the depths of Art Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/3c7b25990481dbe5af0f362787508cfde7ecc914.png[/img]

The first sketch was drawn on my knee while riding the bus home. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/5844e327f8137364339428d078f1e871e21b1906.png[/img]

When the idea of adding a deity with south-African mythology vibes as a mentor was approved by everyone, we began to delve deeper and search for his mood. Hat-Long Nose and Mask, these distinctive features determined further iterations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/0a5684623b420477394c1aca593d88fcb937f6c9.jpg[/img]

The color palette in shades of green and purple emphasized the character's connection to the afterlife. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/0db6dd459478db9e68d58f3b64a252e6a31c3dc1.png[/img]

The jewelry, the spikes on the metal nose and the smile accentuated the eccentricity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/af3029f08ae25b62f1016025e7dd7f15b8638d79.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/37224df770d91d32854f2c3cb897aa705450b902.png[/img]

In 2019, there was an idea for Samedi (though at the time we just called him Baron) to carry around a strange-looking coffin in which he collected the souls given to him by the hero. Later on, we decided to remove it because it was too cumbersome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/8379e2a97d4d5280061cce16a68bc5dbb9504fdc.jpg[/img]

We didn't revisit the character for about a year after that, because he didn't appear in the game at the time, and we only came back to him when we were working on our first Kickstarter trailer. After a year of work, the team's skills grew and we were able to shape the final design. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/bde5d98245ab1b62aa128f8b8316f59b59aa97af.png[/img]

The butterflies symbolized rebirth.... which Samedi patiently deals with in relation to the blond boy. 
Next, we iterated his game sprite.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/a395beeee72b2c640adf2c95074c5882acb2b79d.jpg[/img]

As a result, good old Samedi got his present form…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/dde4fbb1a839a8489f92f13b95b55689e220d3b5.jpg[/img]

I also think we owe it to Marcelo Orsi to show the process of creating the best illustration of Samedi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/559be3d5b15f50900aa4c46e41d8240f9d9f9faf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/a62bb0dfa9f213531602cdf4a976defaa60f0e9d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/3f0bd8760395c9e91b8640ed84caf9f9ddbe3069.png[/img]

P.S.
This doesn't show everything we have on this charismatic character.... so my advice, blondie, is to make sure your karma is green by the end of the game.

notes.title: Three days until release! Early development of the game
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings!

Our team wants to remind you that only three days are left until There is No Light's PC release![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132980/There_Is_No_Light/

[h3]Pre-purchase now with a bigger discount than on the launch day and with an exclusive bonus![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/fb92ac050047f3600b12ee6552365335595fd8db.gif[/img]

[h3]In today's update, we'd like to lift the curtain a bit more regarding the early stages of development of There is No Light, its game mechanics and how it evolved over the years.[/h3]

The game has changed its look three times, from the prototype to the final visual style.

The earliest version of the game dates back to December 2018. It was at that time that the prototype was developed, which looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/8be40be3a27953c3bed13295bff5744cae0d2e0d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/ddd02551f21c66aba4e5e56369d368b3864ccf9b.png[/img]

I think this version was the closest to "there's no light here", even compared to the current one. Interesting fact: in the prototype, the hero could kick objects and shoot with his hand. Even at that stage, the hero could accumulate rage from damaging enemies or the environment. From the prototype, only the rage system made it to the release version, everything else was either cut out or converted into new mechanics.

After the prototype, the development phase of the demo version of the game started. The visual style changed again. The secret bunker and underground tunnel were chosen for the first locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/ac88ddde85f6547d270e98765d7ed4e3e3f48885.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/c909d0e7d38e9bb9ee243765b69b93e7ddbd85c4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/1e99cf5161b44484d079ee6cba126de59551786a.png[/img]

At that point, the hero acquired an ability that could be used when the rage was accumulated, replacing the arm shots in the prototype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/d1b791dfb4276559b6182843531f40e3a4ac91e7.png[/img]

The hero could also collect crystal pieces and use them as objects. Some crystals healed the hero, while others worked as grenades that exploded when thrown. Crystals also didn't make it to the release version, as they slowed down the game pace and their use was too long and inconvenient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/dd366699b1baf3a2a3c126e2de8551e21335d85f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/5b14ac823bfcbf29b99a7dc98a85bf45f1407943.jpg[/img]

The demo version ended with an underground tunnel, which seamlessly transitioned into an infernal location with a mini-boss, after defeating which the demo ended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/5c71a400398f6c9b62f598d6bcf134be1fb23e1e.jpg[/img]

After completing the demo, we began the final search for the game's visual style. At this stage, the game smoothly started to acquire the look that you will be able to see upon the game's release on September 19.

notes.title: 1 Week until Release! Behind the scenes of the animated trailer production!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings! Today we wanted to remind you that There is No Light is releasing just in one week, on September 19 on Steam! [/h3]
[h3]And in the meantime, you can preorder the game with bigger discount AND an exclusive skin for the Hero's companion![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132980/There_Is_No_Light/

[h3]And to make this announcement more interesting for you, we'd invited our friends from the [url=https://instagram.com/toadanimation]TOAD Animation[/url] team to make a behind the scenes post of our release date trailer wich you probably saw on the IGN a few months back. Hope you'll like this update![/h3]

Croak to all!

In this article, we ([url=https://instagram.com/toadanimation]the TOAD Animation team[/url]) would like to share our experience in creating an animated teaser clip for the game There is no Light. In general, every studio can produce a piece about their own work pipeline and some aspects of it, big or small, will always differ. Even from project to project, within the same team! It depends both on the artists themselves and their approach to problem solving, as well as on the customers of a particular project. 

This work was particularly easy thanks to the game's developers, who knew exactly what they wanted from the clip and provided kind of a draft storyboard with a description of certain details that concerned the game’s lore and mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/8a2fb45268df7af7dc73d6b1124365d8ea212159.png[/img]

So, as there was no need to do the storyboard separately, we jumped straight to the animatic (i.e. the first draft clip which includes not only visuals, but also timings of all scenes). Animatic allows us to estimate more precisely the amount of work, complexity, number of scenes and make that_table (the holy table of any project) where we will mark completeness of all scenes. Because it's still just a draft, animatic doesn't look that impressive, but it allows you to present the reel, plus it’s a generator of funny faces. 

As they say, "expectation" and "reality":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/665961dcebea620ed830ae23de30adb1e5aa9986.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/11d9ea1a72d518986f530c6db3c5d86ae073958e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/4c2c9b26ac830585ac752a264b9a82fa80fbc632.png[/img]

Parallel to this (at least in our studio), the concept work is underway. Creating the protagonist and forming the style of the video itself are definitely one of the most important parts of the production. We usually spend quite a lot of time on that stage. And in general, it's difficult to estimate the pre-production timeframe, because it’s not always possible to hit the bullseye with the character design right away (the main thing here is, as with everything else, not to get discouraged and keep working with trial and error)! And the devil may also be in the details here: change the shape of a head or hair a bit, add a shadow, and the character sparkles with new colors, becomes original/attractive/interesting. Working with a pixel character that becomes a "cartoon" has its own undeniable advantages. Good design decisions are already incorporated in a pixel game model, with some leeway in the matter of forms – because a silhouette of the pixel model is not that complicated, you can experiment, add various refinements to the design of clothing or weapons. 

And here go these endless evolutions of the main characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/80a2528cdddd7d29908f8876bc4f52df6b23b9e3.png[/img]

And when our main character was found, after a pompous celebration of that emportant event, we began to design the other participants of the clip. And, based on the already finished and approved concept, the work with the remaining villains (and they were mostly the protagonist's enemies) went faster. But you never know what dangers might await you at the turn! For example: the helmet of a large and intimidating villain who emerges from the darkness of the tunnel, glowing with blue flames. There were so many variations of his head that we could easily create an entire CCG out of them. Here are just a few, the most desperate and forced out of them all:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/f75fcba365c334d031b3f5cb6282e2ab6fd83526.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/91674dca0132d815069e6b9cb8bebd3744452ecd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/093d136c9306520359a4c744d2dfee6ae1024f8a.png[/img]

And of course an important detail of any production - the color script (оr kind of a guideline for background designers and composers). This is where the search for colour solution is done. The feel of the picture. The way the character would fit into the environment. On this project, we had three main options that we came up with and eventually settled on the first one! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/f890dd69e82f16e090ab5803e96a76ee48eee19d.png[/img]

After that goes the most favourite part, which is assembling the now-ready material to recreate a test frame of what the project should look like in the end. Here's the recipe: we take one finished layout that's already rendered according to approved scene with approved designs, then we take the finished (with color script taken into account) background, paint the layout and throw it all into kitchen blender. Or any available program with suitable functionality, like Photoshop. Sprinkle a few effects on top and voila~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/0ea1b979050d20fb7dd61dd9f3eb11b9cd17a05b.png[/img]

When the animatics, designs, colour script and test frame of the project are approved, we’re getting down to the quieter part. The part where you board the train called "production" that rides the rails, where the team brings the project closer to its finish line, scene by scene. From the layout to the final result, when the whole material can be safely handed over to composer (sometimes it seems that composer just presses the "make it look good" button and the whole picture acquires the longed-for depth, gets effects, but in reality it is a painstaking and long job).

If we were to describe all the subtleties of animation to this article, I'm afraid it would turn into a book, so to make it clear, here's a gif with one stage of production following the other. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/05b9bd6a184758b4d93d1a76567ad6ba3b397452.gif[/img]

And so the video has reached the finish line, taking its shape. Working with such great designs and such an atmospheric game is an unbelievable pleasure! We tried to keep the dark tone of the narrative while adding bright, almost neon accents to the picture. The whole team is waiting for the final release of the game to enjoy its gameplay and the colorful pixel art. 

In conclusion, I'd like to say that there's no single "how-to" rule for anything, probably. Any creativity is inherently freedom of artistic thought, and how that work is diced is a purely individual decision, which depends more on the team itself. We only tried to cope with this work as well as possible, and please not only the client, but also future viewers. Yet if this text managed to somehow lift the veil of production or help to understand how a full-fledged animation video is born from an idea, we were very glad to share it! 

And voilà! here is the final result, if you had missed it 😉

[previewyoutube=5Vu4XJTAHnI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://instagram.com/toadanimation]Follow our social media accs[/url], croak to all, and thank you very much for your attention![/h3]

notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!

We’re back with some awesome news! Just in a few weeks, we’re releasing a free ver. of There is No Light with an exclusive Arena mode! Apart from Arena, the game will contain three locations and a Boss fight that you might have seen in our last demo that was released during the last Steam Next Festival.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700700/There_Is_No_Light_616/

[h3]
This free ver. will be called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700700/There_Is_No_Light_616/]There is No Light 616[/url] and will be available for a limited time period, so hurry to install the game in the very first days after release![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/cd72d1667005f60849bd2e02d755f331641489bd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/72c41ddfe8a66f852fcef50c3e4395aad3469a63.png[/img]

[h3]So, why does [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700700/There_Is_No_Light_616/]There is No Light 616[/url] deserve your attention if you have played our last demo back in June?

[list]
[*]
We’ve gathered all the feedback from you and very much improved the demo according to it. The enemies and combat system became more diverse and better, the healing system also became more accessible plus the demo has a much better tutorial. So if there was anything that made you feel confused or maybe even disappointed the last time you tried the demo, there is a huge chance that you’ll be surprised by how much the game has changed since then!

[*]New! Arena! Mode![/list][/h3]

[h1]Black Book is coming out TODAY[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

[h3]We're excited to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/]Black Book[/url], an upcoming dark RPG Adventure based on Slavic myths, will come out on the 222nd day of the year 2021 (i.e. August 10). All players will be able to get it with a 15% discount during the first week after the release.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/b474a42ff310a3018790a2757fc4dc51578692b3.jpg[/img]

[h3]There is No Light and Black Book have a lot in common, such as rich storytelling, a grim setting, and a strong protagonist who is fighting the evil forces.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/]Black Book[/url] will feature a full English voiceover, extensive story dialogues consisting of more than 150k words, and more than 20 hours of gameplay.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/a8167a8faa0dffcfb1d8d2b31b46313840fb188e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Black Book is a haunting tale of a young sorceress Vasilisa seeking the power of Black Book to revive her beloved one. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures. Dive into the cold, yet alluring world of Slavic folktales — and uncover the secrets that hide in the darkness.[/h3]
